accounts.name: employee
docs: Employee account associated with the creator.
Validated automatically during deserialization through constraints:
1. The employee's owner field must match the signer (prevents impersonation).
2. The employee must be active (active == true).
3. The employee must have permission to create polls (allow_create_poll == true).

accounts.name: employee_main_role
docs: Department account associated with the creator. Used to retrieve the employee's level and check it against the global PollConfig settings.
Validated automatically during deserialization through constraints:
1. The employee's main_role_key field must match the public key of the supplied role account.
2. Do not validate the department level here because an employee may have a temporary level.

errors.name: NameTooLong
errors.msg: Name is too long: the maximum length is 32 bytes.

errors.name: TooManyParameters
errors.msg: Too many arguments.

errors.name: TooManyVecItem
errors.msg: Too many arguments: a single transaction can process at most 20 vector elements.

errors.name: CanNotBeEmpty
errors.msg: Arguments cannot be empty or zero-length dynamic values.

errors.name: LevelError
errors.msg: Invalid permission level: values must be 0–31, and the minimum level cannot exceed the maximum (if specified).

errors.name: EmployeeIDError
errors.msg: Invalid or out-of-sync employee ID.

errors.name: DepartmentNotFound
errors.msg: Department does not exist.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.msg: Role does not exist.

errors.name: EmployeeNotFound
errors.msg: Employee does not exist.

errors.name: AddressMismatchError
errors.msg: Multiple arguments that should resolve to the same address do not match. Check the client logic.

errors.name: ChangeRoleError
errors.msg: Invalid role change: the old and new roles must differ.

errors.name: IllegalPollIntervalTime
errors.msg: Invalid poll duration.

errors.name: StringTooLong
errors.msg: String is too long: the maximum length is 64 bytes.

errors.name: MultipleChoicesError
errors.msg: The number of choices must be between 1 and 20.

errors.name: IllegalTimeStamp
errors.msg: Invalid timestamps: the start time must be before the end time and cannot be in the past.

errors.name: TooShortInterval
errors.msg: Poll duration cannot be shorter than min_polling_interval in PollConfig, which is configured by an administrator.

errors.name: TooLongInterval
errors.msg: Poll duration cannot exceed max_polling_interval in PollConfig, which is configured by an administrator.

errors.name: PollStatusUpdateError
errors.msg: Invalid poll status update: Draft can be changed to Ready only when is_ready is Some(true).

errors.name: MutexVec
errors.msg: Allowlist/blocklist conflict: the same entry cannot appear in both lists.

errors.name: CandidateNotFound
errors.msg: Candidate not found.

errors.name: ShouldBeEqParameters
errors.msg: Invalid arguments: the two supplied values must match.

errors.name: DuplicateChoicesError
errors.msg: Invalid arguments: the same candidate cannot be selected more than once.
